referenceFunction.generalComment: Individual hydrocarbons are estimated based on the share of diesel engines of road vehicles. Heavy metals are estimated from trace elements in fuel. A distinction between distilled (28%) and residual fuel (72%) is applied. Amount of disposed bilge oil is estimated as 0.6% of the consumed fuel.; UUID: 6aa55fe1-55f9-3ebd-aa76-4ee8187a2027
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The inventory includes the supply of fuel. Direct airborne emissions of gaseous substances, particulate matters, dioxins, PAHs, halogens and heavy metals are accounted for. Also, the disposal of bilge oil, emissions of oil (regular and spills of small accidents) and emissions of tributyltin compounds are included. The spill of oil due to huge accidents is not included.
referenceFunction.name: xxx Operation, transoceanic tanker

technology.text: Average data for steam turbine (62%) and diesel engine (38%) propulsion. The fuel used is Heavy Fuel Oil (HFO). Fuel consumption and emissions are representative for slow speed engine types (speed: 14 knots per hour) and a tanker size between 50"000-300"000 dwt.
